lessons.title: Vocabulário
lessons.goal: Aprender o vocabulário da unidade: Educação (degree, course, subject, assignment, exam, grade, scholarship, deadline), verbos (attend, enrol, graduate, revise).

aula.text: **Verbos:** attend (frequentar), enrol (matricular-se; no inglês americano, enroll), graduate (formar-se), pass / fail (passar / reprovar), revise (revisar para a prova), take an exam (fazer uma prova).

items: "I will make an exam tomorrow." *Make an exam* quer dizer elaborar a prova. O certo é **take an exam.**
"I assist the lectures." O certo é **I attend the lectures.**
"I'm graduated in engineering." O certo é **I graduated in engineering** ou **I have a degree in engineering.**

exercises.prompt: I have an ___ tomorrow, so I need to revise tonight.
She won a ___, so she doesn't pay tuition fees.
I will make an exam tomorrow.
acc: I will take an exam tomorrow

exercises.prompt: I assist the lectures every Monday.
acc: I attend the lectures every Monday
I have a degree in engineering

lessons.title: First conditional e orações de tempo
lessons.goal: Dominar a gramática da unidade: First conditional (if + presente, will + infinitivo), orações de tempo (when, as soon as, until, before, after), unless.

head: Estrutura
Uso
Exemplo
rows: If I pass the exam, I'll celebrate.
when / as soon as / until / before / after + present simple
I'll call you as soon as I arrive.
Unless you study, you won't pass.

aula.text: **Regra de ouro:** nunca use *will* logo depois de if, when, as soon as ou until.
Na oração principal também vale *can*, *may*, *should* ou imperativo: *If you see her, tell her to call me.*

items: "If I will pass, I will celebrate." O certo é **If I pass, I'll celebrate.**
"When I will arrive, I call you." O certo é **When I arrive, I'll call you.**
"Unless you don't study, you will fail." O certo é **Unless you study...** (unless já é negativo)

lessons.title: Inglês prático, pedir informações sobre um curso
lessons.goal: Usar o inglês prático da unidade: Pedir informações sobre um curso e se inscrever.

head: Situação
Frases
rows: I'd like some information about the course. / When does the course start? / How long is the course? / How much are the fees?
Is there a discount or a scholarship? / Is it possible to pay in instalments?
Do I need any previous experience? / What documents do I need?
I'd like to enrol on the course. / Where can I sign up?
Could you send me the details by email?

items: "I want to make an English course." O certo é **take** (ou **do**) **an English course.**
"Is possible to pay in instalments?" O certo é **Is it possible...?** (o *it* é obrigatório)
